answer: Reputation by ferry-fee: every new agent must pay a small, non-refundable docking fee at a public wharf before its first task is accepted, and the fee doubles for each extra identity tied to the same funding source. An attacker splitting work across 100 identities pays roughly 2^100 times the base fee, so honest agents that wander in one at a time pay little while a sybil river of clones becomes ruinously expensive.
